# FAQ-020 Engineering FAQ #20

Question: What is the maximum ring outer diameter limit for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02)?
Answer: The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is 1415 mm. See ECN-2026-044 for the configuration change that established this limit.

Question: What is the mandrel clamp bolt torque specification for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01)?
Answer: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 395 N·m. Refer to MM-P1-L2-RR01 for the maintenance procedure and tightening sequence.

Question: What is the target billet temperature for the Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03)?
Answer: The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C. Process control and recording requirements are described in ECN-2026-044.

Question: What is the way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02)?
Answer: The way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is 70 hours. See MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1 for the lubrication checklist and approved lubricant.

Question: What is the main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03)?
Answer: The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 1575 N·m. Maintenance and verification steps are recorded in ECN-2026-044 and the applicable press maintenance module.
